evidence: comment: 'opensource COBOL and AWS Lambda sample program'

purpose.domain_detail: AWS Lambda integration demo using GnuCOBOL; reads an invitee CSV list and matches input personal data (name, birth date) to return a JSON response suitable for AWS Lambda
purpose.summary: This program accepts personal data (first name, last name, birth year/month/day) from console input, reads an INVITEE_LIST.csv file, and checks whether the input matches any record. It then constructs a JSON string (mimicking an AWS Lambda response with statusCode 200) and displays it, returning a return_code of 0 on match or -1 on no match.

notable_features: AWS Lambda JSON response construction via STRING verb
INSPECT TALLYING for substring length detection
ACCEPT FROM CONSOLE for Lambda input
CSV file reading with sequential READ INTO
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COPY statements
verdict.notes: The program is a self-contained demo/sample explicitly labeled as an 'opensource COBOL and AWS Lambda sample program'. The missing period after PIC X(29) on line 22 may be a minor syntax issue. No COMP-3, no COPY, no CALLs. Fixed format confirmed by max_line_length=72 and no long lines.
